name: OKC_SECTIONS_B
description: The formatting of a contract consists of a series of sections. These sections generally have a heading and may have a label, such as "I. Definitions" or "V. Indemnity, Warranties, and Remedies". Sections may have sub-sections. Sections are composed of clauses or lines. Sections may also be used to format standard clause sets. In this case, the section contents are standard clauses.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier. Primary key of the table.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the Section

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Version Type of the Object. It can have following values "C"urrent , "A"mendment and "H"istory.

columns.name: SCN_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if the section refers to a contract header or a standard clause set.

columns.name: SECTION_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Sequence number for the section

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Label to be printed for the section such as III. or 3.

columns.name: SCN_ID
columns.description: Indicates parent section for this subsection

columns.name: LIBRARY_SCN_ID

columns.name: DISABLED
